title: Expansión highlights Burford’s growth in Spain
summary: Legal finance continues to gain momentum in Spain as businesses and law firms seek new ways to manage complex disputes. Expansión features Burford Co-Founder and Chief Investment Officer Jonathan Molot, Senior Vice President Teresa Gutiérrez Chacón and Senior Vice President Florencia Villaggi discussing Burford’s growing presence in Spain, its approach to selecting investments and the opportunities it sees for further growth.
body_markdown:
Legal finance continues to gain momentum in Spain as businesses and law firms seek new ways to manage complex disputes. Expansión features Burford Co-Founder and Chief Investment Officer[Jonathan Molot](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/jonathan-molot/) , Senior Vice President[Teresa Gutiérrez Chacón](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/teresa-gutierrez-chacon/) and Senior Vice President[Florencia Villaggi](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/florencia-villaggi/) discussing Burford’s growing presence in Spain, its approach to selecting investments and the opportunities it sees for further growth.


[Read the full article here](https://www.expansion.com/juridico/actualidad-tendencias/2026/10/06/burford-crece-refuerza-equipo-mercado-espanol.html) .
